# package csipaus

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-ieee20305/csipaus"
```

Package csipaus is the CSIP-AUS (Common Smart Inverter Profile, Australia) v1.3 profile of IEEE 2030.5, generated from the official CSIP-AUS schemas.

CSIP-AUS redefines some IEEE 2030.5 types to append elements in its own namespace (Namespace), such as the dynamic operating envelope limits of DERControlBase and the connection point of EndDevice. This package holds those redefined types, the types that contain them (such as DERControl and DERControlList), and the types of the CSIP-AUS namespace. Every other type is the one of the base package ieee20305.

Marshal, Unmarshal and Decode encode and decode documents of both packages. CSIP-AUS v1.3 profiles IEEE 2030.5-2018, so Marshal does not write the schemaVer attribute of IEEE 2030.5-2023.

Limits are the site limits CSIP-AUS adds to DERControlBase. Package csipserver configures a server for CSIP-AUS, and package csipclient reads and writes the ConnectionPoint of a device.

The \*\_gen.go files are generated; do not edit them.

Decode decodes an XML document of any document type. Documents that CSIP-AUS changes decode into the types of this package, others into the types of the base package.

### func Marshal

```go
func Marshal(v any) ([]byte, error)
```

Marshal encodes v as an XML document. v is a document type of this package, such as \*DERControl, or of the base package for documents CSIP-AUS does not change.

CSIP-AUS v1.3 profiles IEEE 2030.5-2018, so Marshal writes a 2018 document: it encodes a copy of v reduced to what 2018 defines (its own CSIP-AUS elements stay), without the schemaVer attribute of 2023.

### func Unmarshal

```go

```

Unmarshal decodes an XML document into v, a pointer to a document type of this package or of the base package. An error in the document matches ieee20305.ErrProtocol.

### type Limits

```go
type Limits struct {
	// Export and Import limit the active power at the connection point.
	Export, Import *ieee20305.ActivePower
	// Generation and Load limit the active power of the site's generation
	// and load.
	Generation, Load *ieee20305.ActivePower
	// StorageTarget is the target of the site's storage.
	StorageTarget *ieee20305.ActivePower
}
```

Limits are the site limits of CSIP-AUS, the opMod controls it adds to DERControlBase: a dynamic operating envelope. A nil limit is not set.

#### func LimitsOf

```go

```

LimitsOf returns the site limits of a DERControl, DefaultDERControl or DERControlBase of CSIP-AUS, and whether v is one.
